_doc: Ground truth for laptop/tools/eval_yolo.py. Paths are relative to this file. 'present': recipe objects (or 'hand') visible in the frame; any other class detected counts as a false positive. 'ignore': ambiguous (half visible, mashed, a spoon that might pass as a fork) - neither a hit nor a false positive. Videos: one label set for the whole clip, sampled every 'every' frames, so record clips where the set of objects doesn't change.
